company.name: InpharmD
company.shortDescription: Doctors submit questions, we provide curated, evidence- based answers
company.description:
Clinical pharmacists working at different hospitals are looking up the same answers to the same clinical questions every day. 
InpharmD is a centralized service that eliminates this redundant work.We’ve been bootstrapping since 2018, and in the past month, closed our 8th health system, to put us over $1M ARR (300% YoY growth).

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,050,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,466,390 to $28,734,607, a 6.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
